motion_rule: camera always moving, shot size changes every beat; the rail carries the hero, the depot rips past sideways; something fills the lens each beat; one action per beat; motion across frame or at the lens
character: a spotted hyena, shaggy, no clothes, upright on hind legs, head over a third of the frame, the same hyena throughout, jaw opens on each syllable
second_characters: A SWARM of tiny animal clerks, always a shoulder from the lens, cutting across frame; ONE clerk in striped socks returns three times
props: ONE open chrome rest capsule rolling on a rail, a fat pillow in it; A SWARM of blank-faced alarm clocks, wound and thrown; rubber seals; a paper ribbon spooling from above
prop_continuity: one capsule only, always under him and rolling; its lid stays open until 9.25; the clocks multiply every beat, never fewer
environment: a packed sunlit pension depot, a moving carousel of identical capsules, crates and ribbons an arm away

light_events.event: hard noon sun through tall glass, sunlit walls, hard racing shadows

audio.delivery: male, low, dry, flat, bites off each word, 4.4 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: vsyu ZHIZN, sh-YOL, po-KO-yu, te-PER, dos-TIG, ye-GO, po-KO-ya, ne STA-lo; latin hints are never spoken
audio.pacing: first word on frame one, last word ends by 7.75, after it bells, seals and rail clatter fill the track
audio.lip_sync: accurate, jaw opens on every syllable

timeline.action: muzzle fills the lens, he rides the open chrome capsule as the rail rips it sideways past the crowd; A SWARM winds blank-faced alarm clocks along its rim
still rolling, he hurls one clock across frame past the lens; A SWARM flings three more back at him
the capsule dives under a falling paper ribbon and he bats it aside with both paws; ONE clerk in striped socks runs the rim
the capsule swings at the lens, he throws his paws wide over the pillow, muzzle filling frame; A SWARM thuds seals on the rim a shoulder away
the capsule locks onto the moving carousel of identical capsules and the whole wall sweeps past the lens; A SWARM leaps aboard with clocks
riding on, he slams the lid over his head and every blank-faced clock on it goes off at once, the capsule bucking at the lens
he throws the lid back and hurls a pawful of ringing clocks across frame; A SWARM returns twice as many
he flings the pillow into the lens, the carousel racing on behind his back; ONE clerk in striped socks rides his rim
he yanks the lid shut over himself, muzzle mashed flat on the glass a shoulder from the lens, jaw wide; a giant seal thuds down on the lid as the carousel rips past

must_appear: the open capsule under him at 0.00; clocks thrown at 1.50 and 7.75; ribbon at 2.55; carousel from 5.20; all bells at once 6.15-7.75; lid shut and sealed at 9.25; every line spoken by 7.75
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, gloom, night, dark scene, digits, a clock dial with numbers, an inscription, garbled words, Latin letters, a static camera, a still background, an empty room, standing in place, an establishing shot, walking away from the lens, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, English speech, extra limbs, a second hyena in frame, clerks grabbing or carrying the hyena, the capsule halting on the rail, a repeated or stuttered word
